proposed_workflow.title: Extract main heading from example.com

blocks.label: extract_main_heading
blocks.code:
await page.goto("https://example.com")
await page.wait_for_selector("p")
h1 = page.locator("h1")
if await h1.count() > 0:
    heading = (await h1.first.inner_text()).strip()
    source = "h1"
else:
    heading = (await page.locator("p").first.inner_text()).strip()
    source = "first paragraph (page has no h1)"
page_title = await page.title()
first_paragraph = (await page.locator("p").first.inner_text()).strip()
link_texts = await page.locator("a").all_inner_texts()
links = [t.strip() for t in link_texts if t.strip()]
return {"heading": heading, "source": source, "title": page_title, "paragraph": first_paragraph, "links": links}
